observations.description: Barcelona work down the right against Betis, who defend near the edge of their area.
Kounde combines on the right, as established in the retained identity-reviewed example.
A low delivery is played across the face of goal from the right.
Ferran Torres finishes from close range. The ball is in the net.
Ferran Torres, shirt 7, celebrates; the score updates to 1-1.

lines.text: Barcelona, working it down the right.
Betis keep their shape on the edge of the box.
They create the overlap, then Torres attacks the space in front of goal.
Torres gets there ahead of his marker.
